doctrine: Borrow mechanics such as system clarity, identity application logic, carrier variation, clean modern tech framing.
Lead with crisp product proof and keep decorative atmosphere secondary.
Build confidence through whitespace, pacing, and calm editorial hierarchy.
Use one convincing showcase move per frame instead of equal-weight mosaics.
Use one confident scale shift or crop move rather than many competing gestures.
constraints: Do not borrow literal elements such as their logos, their typography, their campaign copy.
Treat this as transferable mechanics only, not direct brand truth or copy.
Keep supporting surfaces subordinate to the main product carrier.
Prefer restraint over visual chatter, crowded proof rows, or ornamental chrome.
anti_patterns: Avoid collage layouts, equal-weight panels, or too many simultaneous focal points.
Avoid generic gradients, novelty effects, or decorative chrome that weakens trust.
Avoid foreign logos, literal copy, or source-specific brand assets in generated work.
component_cues: Project showcases should prioritize one convincing proof move per frame.
Case-study carriers should read as editorial proof, not mosaics.
layout_cues: Layouts should read as curated proof sequences with strong margins and clear grouping.
Composition should anchor around one product frame or proof surface before any supporting insets.
Spacing should stay generous enough that the focal move reads in under five seconds.
Observed section language suggests a structured page rhythm around Channels, Explore, Channels.
motion_cues: Motion should stay restrained and support the main reveal instead of becoming the story.
Use brief transitions and gentle transforms rather than long ambient animation loops.
palette_lines: Strong dark/light contrast carries the hierarchy.
One restrained accent should carry emphasis rather than many competing tones.
typography_lines: Observed type families include gtKotoheimMono, gtKotoheimMono Fallback.
Type should carry hierarchy through scale contrast and restrained support copy.
